subject: delta(client): WF narrow when the README says a reopen sends and name a never-sent transfer that readback marked failed
note: The README's withheldReopen paragraph now matches the reopen rules exactly. A transaction with no intent row is sent on its history alone only when the lane row is absent or holds another, finished transfer; a lane row holding another unfinished transfer is refused. A transaction that was never sent but that a readback later marked failed because another transfer used its nonce stays readback-only, as its rows hold a failure other than withheld. The refusal sentence names the refusals listed before it, which are outcome_unknown. No code changes.
